For @theathletic.com: Much like their defense at the start of last season, the Hurricanes’ forwards have been ravaged by injuries. They’re managing to stay atop the standings anyway — again. 
www.nytimes.com/athletic/771...

The Edmonton Oilers almost handed the game straight to the Hurricanes with their costly mistakes!

PostGaming Presented by @doordash_ca
Hurricanes announce they've activated Seth Jarvis (off-season shoulder surgery) from injured non-roster list.
Seth Jarvis has been activated from IR, and Bradly Nadeau has been reassigned to AHL Chicago.
Brind'Amour says Jarvis "is getting closer." No commitment to him playing tomorrow in Edmonton, but what Brind'Amour shows in practice is usually what he shows in games.
Looks like Jarvis might be a go in Edmonton

In case you missed it, I watched last night's game between the #Canucks and Hurricanes, and there is a ton to talk about.

dailyhive.com/vancouver/i-...

The Stanchies: Hot dogs fall from the sky as Canucks fall 6-3 to the Hurricanes

canucksarmy.com/news/stanchi...
Stankoven ENG makes it 6-3. Ehlers gave up the hat trick to dish to No. 22
Blake down and cut. Chytil gets four minutes.
Ehlers breakaway and he's got his second of the night. I still don't think he's getting the rock if he scores three more this period. 5-3.
Nadeau reading the social media comments about him
Woof, another chance coming out of the box, but O'Connor's bid in all alone is gloved by Kochetkov
Hurricanes back to the PP after O'Connor gets called for a faceoff violation
Sasson out of the box and Nadeau wipes out, takes out Bains' legs, and then Kochetkov is knocked out of the play to allow Vancouver to tie it.
Sasson takes a bad neutral zone penalty, hooking Slavin. Canes back to the PP
Good to see Ehlers back out there for the end of the power play
Now Ehlers is hurt, favoring his right leg.
Karlsson to the box for hooking on Nadeau. Carolina to the PP.
The Deslauriers-Kotkaniemi-Nadeau line has one shot attempt so far tonight — Deslauriers' goal
